description: Review-only verified Week 7 injury events and Oct 26 follow-ups; official GB Jacob Monk IR transaction and previously untracked NE Romeo Doubs IR status added. Week 8 projections unchanged absent measured beneficiary usage.

events.review_focus: Week 7 routes and targets by receiver; Waddle's prior 38 targets and 7 Week 7 targets; do not redistribute until Week 8 availability confirmed.

2026-10-26 coach Mike Macdonald reports positive early returns on knee injury. Still no Week 8 clearance. Do not redistribute targets to Tory Horton or Seattle WRs without official absence and measured routes/targets.

Week 7 observed: Emanuel Wilson 24 carries, 100 rushing yards, 1 TD with Zach Charbonnet unavailable and Velus Jones Jr. exiting. 2026-10-26: Jadarian Price return-to-practice window planned, while Charbonnet was activated from PUP Oct 22 but OUT Week 7. Check both players' Week 8 activation/status and George Holani snaps/routes before giving Wilson a starter-absence boost.

2026-10-26 NFL Network: MRI confirmed high ankle sprain; Seattle hopes absence limited to 1-2 weeks, not a Week 8 OUT designation. Josh Jones replaced Cross in Week 7. Monitor Week 8 practice/official game status, pressure rates and run-blocking before adjusting Darnold, pass catchers or RBs.

events.injury: left knee (aggravation of previously sprained MCL)
events.review_focus: 2026-10-26 ESPN Schefter reports knee issue not considered significant and Jones is day-to-day; Week 8 at DET remains unresolved. Week 7: Jordan Mason 38 offensive snaps and 15 carries for 68 yards versus Jones 15 snaps, 8 carries and 1 target; review Mason routes, pass protection, red-zone work and Jones practice before reallocating. Do not treat Jones as ruled out or assign full backfield to Mason.

2026-10-26 NFL Network reporting indicates a suspected high-ankle sprain, with X-rays negative and MRI pending. Packers coach Matt LaFleur already expected both Sean Rhyan and Jacob Monk to miss Thursday Week 8 against Carolina. Review John Williams' Week 7 center snaps, pass-blocking pressure, rushing efficiency, and short-week offensive line lineup. Do not assign a confirmed diagnosis, Week 8 OUT designation, IR transaction, or automatic projection change without official confirmation.

Coach Dave Canales confirmed fracture and extended absence; rookie Monroe Freeling replaced Moton and started Carolina's first four games. Panthers at Packers Thursday Oct 29. Review Freeling's Week 1-4 and Week 7 pressure rates, run-blocking and team pass-protection, especially with GB center Sean Rhyan also injured. This is a protection downgrade watch, not an offensive target redistribution or an unmeasured PPR penalty.

OFFICIAL Packers Oct 26: Jacob Monk placed on injured reserve (quadriceps), unavailable for Week 8 Thursday vs Carolina and at least four games. Mekhi Becton promoted from practice squad as guard roster depth, not confirmed as replacement center. Sean Rhyan's high ankle sprain remains suspected with no official Week 8 OUT designation; John Williams played emergency center Week 7. Verify starting center and compare Williams/Rhyan pass-blocking pressure, run-blocking and center snap data before changing Jordan Love or Josh Jacobs PPR. No direct WR/TE target redistribution.

Week 7 Tracy left with hamstring issue. Cam Skattebo logged 17 rushes for 124 yards and one TD but also reported hamstring discomfort; Devin Singletary scored in overtime. Giants are on Week 8 bye; no Week 8 fantasy start recommendation. Reassess for Week 9, with both backs' recovery and route/target splits.

NFL Network's Mike Garafolo reports Skattebo expected to be OK after late-game hamstring concern. Week 8 bye means no immediate waiver or PPR redistribution. Week 7 17 rushes, 124 yards and 1 TD; assess practice/health before Week 9.

Coach DeMeco Ryans confirmed turf toe and Noel reportedly wore a boot after the game. Texans have Week 8 bye; review Noel's Week 7 routes/targets and teammates' route share and absences before making any Week 9 target redistribution. No severity grade or recovery timeline confirmed.

2026-10-26 coach Mike Macdonald: 21-day return-to-practice window planned this week. Price remains on IR; practice designation is not activation or clearance to play Week 8. His return could reduce Emanuel Wilson/George Holani opportunities; separately verify Zach Charbonnet Week 8 availability and observed snaps, rushes, targets, routes and goal-line work before ranking changes.

New 2026-10-26 NFL Network Ian Rapoport report: hairline fracture confirmed after Week 7 absence; expected minimal games missed, not placed on IR. Week 8 Thursday vs CAR availability unresolved; Green Bay already without Edgerrin Cooper (Achilles). Check official Thursday designation and Week 7 linebacker snaps/tackles before IDP boost or Carolina run matchup adjustments. No verified offensive targets/routes redistribution; do not change standard PPR projections.

events.injury: torn patellar tendon (season-ending; confirmed by head coach Oct 20)
events.review_focus: Official Oct 20 team confirmation: out for remainder of 2026; Oct 26 coach comments point to increased Antonio Williams activity. Week 6 after McLaurin left: Antonio Williams 45/67 offensive snaps (67%), 4/35 targets (11%), 3-50 receiving; Diggs 41 snaps, 7 targets; Okonkwo 51 snaps, 7 targets; Burks 37 snaps, 6 targets; Brown 33 snaps, 1 target. Through Week 6 season target shares: Diggs 20.3%, McLaurin 14.4%, Williams 13.9%, Okonkwo 10.7%, Burks 9.1%. Review routes, personnel, coverage and red-zone use; prioritize Williams opportunity and Diggs/Okonkwo stable roles, avoid automatic fixed target redistribution or unsupported PPR boosts.

Previously untracked, NOT a new Oct 26 injury: Patriots officially placed Doubs on IR Oct 19; out Week 8 at Miami Nov 1. In Week 7 without Doubs, Brown 49/54 offensive snaps, 6 targets; Douglas 35 snaps, 4 targets; Hunter Henry 41 snaps, 7 targets; Chism 34 snaps, 1 target; Kyle Williams 21 snaps, 1 target (Week 7 snap and box-score reports). Check routes per dropback, targets per route, slot/outside alignments, Week 6 usage with Brown back, and continuing Mack Hollins absence before projecting redistribution. Prioritize Brown's full-time role and Henry's proven Week 7 targets, Douglas secondary; do not simply add all Doubs targets or automatically boost PPR.
